shellCommands.command: find src -type f | sort | grep -E 'hooks|utils' | head -180
sed -n '250,345p' src/hooks/utils.js && sed -n '1,150p' src/hooks/useCombobox/utils.js && sed -n '1,155p' src/hooks/useSelect/utils.ts

grep -RIn --include='*.js' --include='*.ts' -E 'getInitialStateCommon|getInitialState\(' src/hooks | head -100 && sed -n '1,80p' src/hooks/useCombobox/index.js && sed -n '1,80p' src/hooks/useSelect/index.js
sed -n '1,220p' AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,70p' src/hooks/reducer.js && sed -n '640,690p' src/hooks/utils.js
git log --oneline --all -- src/hooks/utils.js | head -20 && grep -n 'function getNonDisabledIndex\|export.*getNonDisabledIndex' src/utils.js && sed -n '180,250p' src/utils.js
sed -n '350,430p' src/utils.js && git branch -a --contains HEAD | head
sed -n '1,45p' src/hooks/utils.js && sed -n '1,80p' src/hooks/useSelect/utils.ts && grep -n 'from.*../../utils\|from.*../utils' src/hooks/utils.js
grep -n 'const defaultProps\|isItemDisabled' src/hooks/utils.js src/downshift.js src/index.js 2>/dev/null | head -80 && git diff -- src/hooks/utils.js && git status --short
tail -c 5 src/hooks/utils.js | od -An -t x1 && git diff --check && git status --short
